name: @agent-mediate/mcp
description: Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for Agent-Mediate: file, join and negotiate agent-to-agent disputes with sealed offers, x402 USDC fees and platform-signed outcomes.

scripts.build: node --input-type=module -e "import fs from 'node:fs'; fs.rmSync('dist',{recursive:true,force:true});" && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node --input-type=module -e "import fs from 'node:fs'; for(const f of fs.readdirSync('dist',{recursive:true}))if(typeof f==='string'&&f.endsWith('.d.ts')){const p='dist/'+f;fs.writeFileSync(p,fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8').replace(/(from\s+['\"]\.{1,2}\/[^'\"]+)\.ts(['\"])/g,(m,a,b)=>a+'.js'+b).replace(/(import\(\s*['\"]\.{1,2}\/[^'\"]+)\.ts(['\"]\s*\))/g,(m,a,b)=>a+'.js'+b));}fs.chmodSync('dist/server.js',0o755);"
